buildEvidenceReuse.boundary: Current CI source validation and build results are recorded separately. The 16 exact build-file hashes belong to the previously verified a2 and 8674 preview artifacts and unchanged local dist, not to a freshly downloaded 40d artifact.

method: Compare every previously enumerated runtime/content/dependency/asset/guard file against immutable a2, 8674 and 40d commits and the current working tree.
Verify all frontend working-tree files match 40d and distinguish the changed Writing harness from unchanged source/content/public subtrees.
Compare protected Git paths against the fixed baseline and confirm the guard identity without changing or running it locally.

limitations: Fresh CI job outcomes and browser/runner environments have their own closing retained record.
Previous detailed captures and preview bytes are reused only where their relevant inputs and applicable environment match. Environment differences remain explicit.

separateCurrentBuildVerification.result: Writing checkpoint owner downloaded the fresh 40d preview, verified its archive digest and size and all 16 files against frozen runtime/protected identities.
separateCurrentBuildVerification.auditBoundary: This identity audit checked the owner record and crosslinks it. It did not download or rehash that fresh artifact; its own direct 16-file byte check used the previously verified preview manifest and unchanged local dist.
